entities.name: NR Sidelink Communication
entities.description: Communication between UEs over PC5 interface consisting of unicast, groupcast and broadcast modes.

entities.name: Unicast
entities.description: Point-to-point sidelink communication between two UEs.

entities.name: Groupcast
entities.description: One-to-many sidelink communication within a group of UEs.

entities.name: Broadcast
entities.description: One-to-all sidelink communication where a UE transmits to all nearby UEs.

entities.name: PC5-RRC Connection
entities.description: Logical connection between a pair of Source Layer-2 ID and Destination Layer-2 ID in the Access Stratum for unicast sidelink communication.

entities.name: Source Layer-2 ID
entities.description: Identifier of the transmitting UE in sidelink communication.

entities.name: Destination Layer-2 ID
entities.description: Identifier of the receiving UE in sidelink communication.

entities.name: PC5-RRC Signalling
entities.description: RRC signaling procedures over PC5 interface for sidelink communication.

entities.name: PC5 Unicast Link Establishment
entities.description: Procedure to establish a unicast link over PC5 interface before PC5-RRC signaling can be initiated.
